ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 2.5:1 ratio of low-intensity (black/dark gray) pixels dominant in the central and medial regions to high-intensity (white/light gray) pixels localized on the distal margins.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous low-intensity dark mass across the central fluke; high-contrast white mottling and irregular pixel clusters concentrated along the trailing edge of the right lobe and the peripheral margin of the left distal tip.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a central convergence angle of approximately 55 degrees relative to the lobe baselines.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrated boundary along the trailing edge; pixel-level variations indicate a jagged profile with peaks concentrated on the lateral thirds of each lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave trailing edge curvature resulting in a distinct posterior sweep toward the distal tips.

other_distinctive_markers: Highly irregular, deep-set indentation profile on the far-right distal lobe margin compared to the more uniform serration of the left lobe.
